nodes.title: Fieldwork
nodes.text: A synthetic notebook about observing a changing landscape.

nodes.title: River survey
nodes.text: Follow the river from the upper trail to the crossing. Record the water level and the condition of the banks at each stop.

nodes.title: Weather log
nodes.text: Compare the latest rainfall with recent changes in the channel.

nodes.title: Water samples
nodes.text: Collect samples at the upper trail and the crossing at the same time of day.

nodes.title: Trail map
nodes.text: The path reaches the river at the old stone crossing.

nodes.title: Bank erosion
nodes.text: Photograph exposed roots and compare the banks after heavy rain.

nodes.title: Woodland survey
nodes.text: Record canopy gaps and signs of recent storm damage.

nodes.title: Old stone crossing
nodes.text: A fixed landmark for repeated observations.
